faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions about AI Music Generator

items.question: What music styles can the AI generate?
items.answer: Our AI supports a wide range of genres including pop, rock, jazz, classical, electronic, hip-hop, country, and more. You can specify the style in your prompt or use Custom Mode for precise control.

items.question: Can I write my own lyrics?
items.answer: Yes. In Custom Mode you can write your own lyrics. For best results, aim for two verses of eight lines each. You can also enable Instrumental mode to generate music without lyrics.

items.question: How long can the generated music be?
items.answer: Generated songs are typically 1–4 minutes long. The exact duration depends on the model and the content of your prompt.

items.question: How long does music generation take?
items.answer: Generation usually takes 2–3 minutes. You can monitor progress in real time while the model creates your track.

items.question: Can I download the generated music?
items.answer: Yes. Once generation is complete you can preview and download the audio file directly from the generator.

items.question: Can I use the generated music commercially?
items.answer: Yes, subject to our Terms of Service and the underlying model's licensing terms. We recommend reviewing those terms before publishing commercial work.
